concept.title: The map proposes, the reader decides
concept.shortdesc: The map of meaning is used to propose categories; individual listings are labelled by a reader applying written definitions.

conbody.p: The design uses the map and the reader for different purposes.
The map is good at revealing the overall shape of what exists. That is why it is used to propose categories.

On its own the map is too blunt to decide individual cases, where a service near a boundary could fall either way. So each individual decision is made by a reader applying written definitions. The decision can be checked afterwards, because the reason is recorded.
